title: viola tricolor subvar. hymettia
intro: Viola tricolor subvar. hymettia, commonly known as the Common Pansy or Heartsease, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the viola genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as acting as a sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Viola tricolor subvar. hymettia include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
